business_problem: provides a comprehensive solution for VPP sellers ranging from power generation prediction, floor control, and market bid optimization. It focuses on helping energy sellers create stable revenue in the VPP market by adopting AI-based technologies for power generation prediction and optimization.
solution_summary: Encored Technologies is an energy IT company that uses AI technologies for renewable energy generation prediction and optimization so that it can help electricity sellers create stable revenue in the VPP (Virtual Power Plant) market. To this end, the company built an in-house Weather Research & Forecasting (WRF) model to improve prediction accuracy. Encored Technologies was able to accelerate the process of configuring a cost-optimized HPC cluster by building on Amazon Web Services (AWS) dedicated HPC instances on Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2)— Amazon EC2 Hpc6a and Amazon EC2 Hpc7g To generate weather forecasts, Encored Technologies carries out four calculations a day, with each calculation taking up to two hours using a cluster of 500 cores (maximum 4,000 cores daily), generating approximately 500GB of output every day.
